blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Concept erasure removes copyright-protected, privacy-sensitive, or otherwise undesirable concepts from pretrained text-to-image diffusion models to support content governance and compliance. As erasure requests arrive over time, models must remove new targets without undoing prior erasures. Existing methods do not constrain interference across edits: residual perturbations outside the retain set interact and accumulate, degrading unrelated generations and sometimes collapsing previously erased targets into noise. We propose CEASE ( C ontinual E rasure via A daptive S ubspace E diting), a training-free method that imposes two subspace constraints on a closed-form solver. CEASE adds the token representation of the shared replacement to the solver’s invariance matrix and, when interference is detected, projects the current update onto the orthogonal complement of dominant output directions extracted from cumulative past updates. A closed-form decomposition attributes the accumulated interference to repeated activation of the shared replacement and overlap between successive update directions, showing that the two constraints suppress these respective sources. Across continual erasure of celebrities, artistic styles, and instances, CEASE achieves the most consistent erase--preserve trade-off, while existing methods either degrade general generation or insufficiently erase targets. 1 1 1 Project page: https://continual-erasure.cvmlgroup.web.illinois.edu/
blocks.zh: 概念消除了从预先训练的文本到图像传播模式中删除版权保护、对隐私有敏感认识或其他不可取的概念,以支持内容治理和合规。 随着时间的流逝,模型必须移除新的目标,而不取消先前的消除。 现有方法并不限制编辑之间的干扰:保留套件外的剩余扰动相互作用和累积,贬低不相关的几代人,有时使先前被抹去的目标崩溃成噪音。 我们提出CEASE(C ontinual E rasure通过A daptive S ubspace E diting),这是一种对闭式解析器施加两个子空间限制的无训练方法. CEASE在解析器的偏移矩阵中添加了共享替换的符号表示,当发现干扰时,将当前更新投射到从过去累积更新中提取的主导输出方向的正向补充上. 闭式分解将累积干扰归结为连续更新方向之间重复激活共享替换和重叠,表明这两个制约因素压制了这些各自来源. 在整个名人、艺术风格和实例的持续消除过程中,CEASE实现了最一致的抹去-保守权衡,而现有方法要么使一般一代人退化,要么不足以抹去目标。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Concept erasure aims to remove copyright-protected, privacy-sensitive, or otherwise undesirable concepts from pretrained text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models, making it an important tool for content governance and compliance Gandikota et al. (2023) ; Lu et al. (2024) ; Liu et al. (2026) ; Liu et al. (2025) . In practice, new erasure targets arrive over time Lee et al. (2026) ; George et al. (2025) , extending concept erasure from one-shot to continual editing: the model must remove new targets without allowing later updates to undo prior erasures or degrade generation of unrelated concepts.
blocks.zh: 概念消除旨在从预先训练的文本到图像(T2I)传播模型中去除版权保护、对隐私敏感或其他不可取的概念,使其成为内容治理和遵守Gandikota等人(2023年);Lu等人(2024年);Liu等人(2026年);Liu等人(2025年)。 在实践中,新的消除目标随着时间推移Lee et al. (2026年);George et al. (2025年),将概念消除范围从一发扩大到持续编辑:模型必须删除新的目标,而不能让后来的更新来抵消先前的消除范围或降低产生不相关的概念.

blocks.en: Prior studies report that retained model utility declines when erasure requests are processed sequentially Lee et al. (2026) ; George et al. (2025) . In our experiments, sequentially applying standard erasure methods Gandikota et al. (2024) ; Lu et al. (2024) ; Gong et al. (2024) ; Li et al. (2026) reveals two related failure modes. First, general generation quality declines on prompts unrelated to any erased concept. Second, outputs for some erased targets become incoherent instead of reflecting the prescribed replacement ( e.g. “a person” for a celebrity). Each edit explicitly protects only a finite retain set Gandikota et al. (2024) ; Gong et al. (2024) ; Li et al. (2026) and can therefore perturb embeddings outside it Wuerkaixi et al. (2025) ; Thakral et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 先前的研究表明,当连续处理Lee等人(2026年)的消除请求时,模型效用会下降;George等人(2025年)。 在我们的实验中,先后应用标准消除方法Gandikota等人(2024年);Lu等人(2024年);Gong等人(2024年);Li等人(2026年)揭示了两种相关的失败模式。 首先,一般的生成质量在与任何被删除的概念无关的提示上下降。 第二,一些被删除目标的产出变得不一致,而不是反映规定的替换(例如名人“个人”)。 每次编辑都明确保护只保留有限的Gandikota等人(2024年);Gong等人(2024年);Li等人(2026年),因此可以扰动地嵌入在其外的Wuerkaixi等人(2025年);Thakral等人(2025年)。

blocks.en: These perturbations interact and accumulate across successive updates, making it difficult for existing methods Li et al. (2026) ; Gong et al. (2024) ; Gandikota et al. (2024) to confine the effects of erasure to the target concepts. As shown in Fig. 1 (a), COCO FID on unrelated prompts rises as the number of edits increases Lin et al. (2014) . This exposes a limitation of existing preservation constraints in the continual setting: protecting a finite retain set at each step does not reliably prevent subsequent updates from cumulatively degrading general generation. Beyond image quality, this degradation also weakens the model’s ability to follow prompt semantics: Figure 1 (b) shows that, after 100 edits, the CLIP score on the same prompts falls well below that of the unedited model. This reduced ability to follow prompt semantics may also affect the outcomes of previous erasures, because the replacement outputs for earlier targets depend on the same continually updated weights. Figure 1 (c) illustrates both effects in the baseline models: they corrupt an unrelated scene and produce noise for the erased celebrity, failing to generate the prescribed generic portrait.
blocks.zh: 这些扰动在连续更新的过程中相互作用和积累,使得现有的方法Li等人(2026年);Gong等人(2024年);Gandikota等人(2024年)难以将消除的影响限制在目标概念上。 如图1(a)所示,随着编辑次数的增加,COCO FID在无关的提示上上升(2014年)。 这暴露了在持续环境下现有保全限制的局限性:保护每一步骤设定的有限保留并不能可靠地防止随后的更新累积降低一般一代。 除了图像质量之外,这种降解还削弱了模型遵循即时语义的能力:图1(b)显示,经过100次编辑后,同一提示上的CLIP得分远低于未经编辑的模型. 这种遵循即时语义的能力的下降还可能影响先前消除的结果,因为早期目标的替换产出取决于相同的不断更新的权重. 图1(c)说明了基线模型中的这两种效果:它们腐蚀了一个无关的场景,为被抹去的名人制造噪音,未能产生规定的通用肖像.

blocks.en: To suppress the accumulation of interference in continual concept erasure, we propose CEASE ( C ontinual E rasure via A daptive S ubspace E diting), a training-free method based on two subspace constraints. CEASE adds the token representation of the shared replacement to the invariance matrix of the closed-form solver, preventing subsequent updates from modifying this representation. It also extracts the dominant output directions from cumulative past updates and, when interference is detected, projects the current update onto their orthogonal complement. Theoretically, a closed-form decomposition attributes the accumulated interference to repeated activation of the shared replacement and overlap between successive update directions, and shows that the two designs suppress the respective sources. Empirically, CEASE maintains stable COCO FID throughout the edit sequence and a COCO CLIP score close to the unedited reference after 100 edits, as shown in Fig. 1 (a) and (b). Across continual erasure tasks involving celebrities, artistic styles, and instances, CEASE achieves the most consistent erase–preserve trade-off. On style erasure, CEASE reduces COCO FID by 73% relative to the strongest prior method. Our contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 为了抑制在持续概念消除过程中的干扰积累,我们提出通过A daptive S ubspace E diting 的 CEASE(C ontinual E rasure),这是一种基于两个子空间限制的无训练方法. CEASE在封闭式解析器的偏移矩阵中添加了共享替换的符号表示,使之后的更新无法修改这种表示. 它还从累积的过去更新中提取主导输出方向,当发现干扰时,将当前更新投射到它们的正向补充上. 理论上,闭式分解将累积的干扰归因于连续更新方向之间重复激活共享替换和重叠,并表明两种设计压制了各自的源头. 经验是,如图1(a)和(b)所示,CEASE在整个编辑序列中保持COCO FID的稳定,COCO CLIP的得分接近100次编辑后未经编辑的参考文献。 CEASE通过持续消除涉及名人、艺术风格和实例的任务,实现了最一致的消除-保守权衡。 在风格消除上,CEASE将COCO FID相对于最强的前置方法减少了73%. 我们的贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • We formalize how interference accumulates across edits in continual concept erasure, and derive a closed-form decomposition that attributes it to repeated activation of the shared replacement and overlap between successive update directions. • We introduce two training-free subspace constraints: one keeps the token representation of the shared replacement invariant, while the other steers the current update away from the dominant output directions of past edits, thereby suppressing the two interference sources. • We evaluate continual erasure of celebrities, artistic styles, and instances across multiple diffusion backbones and assess both erasure and preservation; CEASE achieves the best erase–preserve balance among the compared methods while keeping retained concepts recognizable at rates close to the reference model.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models. Text-to-image diffusion models Zhang et al. (2023a) ; Ma et al. (2024) ; Ji et al. (2026) trained on uncurated web data can reproduce copyrighted styles, recognizable identities, and other undesired content, and concept erasure removes such targets from a pretrained model after training. Existing methods fall into three families. Training-based methods fine-tune the model with a concept-suppression objective and a preservation regularizer Gandikota et al. (2023) ; Zhang et al. (2024) ; Kumari et al. (2023) ; Huang et al. (2024) ; Lyu et al. (2024) ; Li et al. (2024) ; Kim et al. (2024) ; Zhao et al. (2024) ; Wu et al. (2025) , with a separate strand hardening the erasure against adversarial prompts Fan et al. (2024) ; Heng and Soh (2023) ; Pham et al. (2024) ; Park et al. (2024) ; their common cost is that each new target requires another fine-tuning loop. Editing-based methods instead update cross-attention projections through a closed-form least-squares solution, from TIME Orgad et al. (2023) and UCE Gandikota et al. (2024) to MACE Lu et al. (2024) , RECE Gong et al. (2024) , and SPEED Li et al. (2026) ; they edit the model in seconds, but their preservation depends on a finite retain set. Non-parametric methods leave the weights untouched and intervene at sampling time Schramowski et al. (2023) ; Das et al. (2024) ; Rando et al. (2022) . All three families are typically evaluated with the full target set known before editing; our study instead evaluates repeated application to an already-edited model.

blocks.en: Sequential Unlearning. Sequential unlearning is closely related to continual learning and online learning Liu et al. (2020) ; Liu et al. (2021a) ; Liu et al. (2021b) ; Liu et al. (2023a) ; Liu et al. (2023b) ; Liu et al. (2024) ; Li et al. (2019) ; Li et al. (2020) ; Li et al. (2021) ; Luo et al. (2023) ; Fischer et al. (2024) ; Zhang et al. (2023b) . While continual learning and online learning typically focus on acquiring new knowledge without forgetting, sequential unlearning poses the complementary challenge of repeatedly removing targeted knowledge without causing unintended forgetting of retained concepts. In deployment, takedown demands and right-to-be-forgotten obligations arrive as a stream. For language models, the locate-then-edit paradigm Meng et al. (2022a) ; Meng et al. (2022b) degrades under repeated application, and mitigations include drift-restraining regularizers Ma et al. (2025) ; Gu et al. (2024) , external edit memories Hartvigsen et al. (2023) ; Wang et al. (2024b) , and projections onto the null space of preserved keys Fang et al. (2025) ; these approaches operate on factual associations, where edits do not share a common redirection target. For diffusion models, Selective Amnesia Heng and Soh (2023) first cast concept forgetting as a continual-learning problem, and later work adds concept-aware masking with distillation Li et al. (2025) , gradient projection against semantically related concepts Lee et al. (2026) , and multi-objective distillation across deletion requests George et al. (2025) ; these methods suppress the degradation as a monolithic quantity without analyzing where it comes from. In contrast, we approach continual erasure from the perspective of cross-edit interference: we trace the failure to the interference that successive edits accumulate on unprotected prompts, and design our method to suppress this interference.

blocks.en: Section 3.1 defines the continual erasure problem and the base closed-form update. Section 3.2 then explains why update noise accumulates under sequential editing. Guided by the two sources identified in this analysis, Sec. 3.3 presents CEASE.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Baselines and Benchmarks. We evaluate on three concept erasure benchmarks adapted from MACE Lu et al. (2024) and SPEED Li et al. (2026) , covering celebrities, artistic styles, and object or character instances. Each benchmark pairs 100 erased concepts with 100 disjoint retained concepts and uses five prompt templates per concept. We compare two groups of baselines: standard erasure methods, comprising the closed-form SPEED Li et al. (2026) , UCE Gandikota et al. (2024) , and RECE Gong et al. (2024) and the training-based ESD Gandikota et al. (2023) and ConAbl Kumari et al. (2023) , and continual-unlearning methods, comprising CUIG-GradProj Lee et al. (2026) and Sculpting Memory Li et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 基线和基准。 我们根据MACE Lu等人(2024年)和SPEED Li等人的三种概念消除基准进行评估。 (2026),涵盖名人,艺术风格,以及对象或人物实例. 每个基准对100个被抹去的概念和100个脱节保留的概念,每个概念使用5个即时模板. 我们比较了两类基线:标准消除方法,包括封闭式SPEED Li等人(2026年)、UCE Gandikota等人(2024年)、RECE Gong等人(2024年)和基于培训的ESD Gandikota等人(2023年)和ConAbl Kumari等人(2023年),以及持续不学习方法,包括CUIG-GradProj Lee等人(2026年)和Sculting Memory Li等人(2025年)。

blocks.en: Metrics. We report CLIP score (CS) ( Hessel et al., 2021 ) for image–prompt alignment, and FID ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) and LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) for the distribution-level and image-level distance from the unedited backbone’s generations, on each of the erase set, the retain set, and 1,000 MS-COCO captions. On the erase and retain sets we add one task-matched fourth metric. For celebrities, Acc is the recognition accuracy of an open-ended VLM judge (Qwen2-VL-7B) Wang et al. (2024a) asked to name the person in the image; for instances, Acc is the CLIP zero-shot top-1 accuracy against the 200 concept candidates; both should drop on the erase set and stay high on the retain set. For styles, the LAION aesthetic score (Aes) ( Schuhmann et al., 2022 ) is a no-reference quality rating on a 1–10 scale that should stay near the unedited reference.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 我们报告CLIP得分(CS)(Hessel等人,2021年)用于图像即时对齐,FID(Heusel等人,2017年)和LPIPS(Zhang等人,2018年)用于与未经编辑的骨干一代的分布级别和图像级别距离,在每组擦除器、保留器和1000个MS-CO字幕上。 在擦除和保留装置上,我们增加了一个任务匹配的第四个度量。 对名人来说,Acc是无限制VLM法官(Qune2-VL-7B)的识别精度. Wang等人(2024a)要求给图像中的人取名;对于实例,Acc是CLIP的0射头-1精度对200个概念候选人的精度;两者都应该在擦除机上投放,并在保留机上保持高位. 对于风格,LAION美学分(Aes)(Shuhmann等人,2022年)是1–10级的无参考质量评分,应保留在未经编辑的参考位置附近.

blocks.en: Implementation Details. The main experiments use Stable Diffusion v1.4 with DPM-Solver sampling and classifier-free guidance 7.5 Rombach et al. (2021) . The per-task anchors are “person” for celebrities, “art” for styles, and “object” for instances. All experiments run on a single H100 GPU. Additional implementation details, including hyperparameters, are provided in Appendix A.1 .
blocks.zh: 执行详情。 主要实验使用Stable Difusion v1.4与DPM-Solver采样和无分类器制导7.5 Rombach 等人(2021年). 每个任务主播是名人“人物”,风格“艺术”和实例“对象”。 所有实验都运行在单一的H100GPU上. 附录A.1提供了其他实施细节,包括超参数。

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1: Celebrity erasure after continually erasing 100 celebrities on SD v1.4. Bold and underline mark the best and second-best edited results.
blocks.zh: 表1:在SD v1.4上持续抹去100名名名人后,名人名言消退. 粗体并突出显示最佳和二佳编辑结果。

blocks.en: We compare CEASE with all baselines after the full 100-step continual erasure sequence, and report the quantitative results on the celebrity, style, and instance benchmarks in Tables 1 , 2 , and 3 , which we discuss in turn below. Across all three tasks, CEASE achieves the most favorable balance between erasure and preservation: it substantially alters the erased concepts while keeping the retained concepts and unrelated generation close to the unedited model, whereas the baselines that erase more deeply do so by corrupting the retain set or MS-COCO prompts as well. Results on the Stable Diffusion v1.5 and v2.1 backbones appear in Appendices A.3 and A.4 , with the same conclusions.
blocks.zh: 并报告表1、表2和表3中名人、风格和实例基准的量化结果。 在所有三项任务中,CEASE都实现了最有利于消除和保护的平衡:它大幅度地改变被消除的概念,同时使保留的概念和不相关的一代接近未经编辑的模型,而通过腐蚀保留集或MS-CO提示来更深刻地抹去这些基线。 稳定扩散 v1.5 和 v2.1 骨干的结果载于附录 A.3 和 A.4 ,结论相同。

blocks.en: Erasure of Celebrities. As shown in Table 1 , continually applying SPEED severely degrades general generation, with quality on both the retain set and COCO deteriorating as edits accumulate. CEASE performs best among the edited methods on nearly all retain and COCO preservation metrics, and the VLM judge almost never names the erased celebrities while still recognizing most of the retained ones. UCE and RECE obtain the lowest erase-set CLIP scores, but their retain-set scores collapse to a similar degree, indicating prompt-independent corruption rather than selective removal; ESD, in contrast, leaves a noticeable fraction of the erased identities recognizable.
blocks.zh: 名人报恩. 如表1所示,继续应用SPEED会严重降低一般生成,保留装置和COCO的质量随着编辑的积累而下降。 CEASE在几乎所有保留和COCO保存度量衡的编辑方法中表现最好, VLM法官几乎从不给被抹杀的名人起名,同时仍然承认大多数保留名人。 UCE和RECE获得最低的擦除设定的CLIP分数,但他们保留设定的分数崩溃到类似程度,表明是迅速独立的腐败,而不是有选择性的去除;相反,ESD留下了被擦除身份中可识别的明显比例.

blocks.en: Table 2: Style erasure after continually erasing 100 artistic styles on SD v1.4. Bold and underline mark the best and second-best edited results.
blocks.zh: 表2:在SD v1.4上持续删除100种艺术风格后,风格消除. 粗体并突出显示最佳和二佳编辑结果。

blocks.en: Table 3: Instance erasure after continually erasing 100 instances on SD v1.4. Bold and underline mark the best and second-best edited results.
blocks.zh: 表3:在持续消除SD v1.4的100个实例之后,消除实例。 粗体并突出显示最佳和二佳编辑结果。

blocks.en: Erasure of Styles. Table 2 shows the style task to be SPEED’s most severe failure, whereas CEASE remains best among the edited methods on all retain metrics and on COCO CLIP score. Sculpting Memory attains lower COCO FID, but at the cost of a substantially more degraded retain set. Importantly, the preservation gain of CEASE does not come from leaving the erased styles unchanged: it still lowers the erase-set CLIP score substantially, and its erase-set aesthetic score stays at the reference level, showing that the redirected outputs remain coherent paintings, whereas RECE and CUIG-GradProj produce aesthetically collapsed images.
blocks.zh: 风格之恩 表2显示了作为SPEED最严重失败的样式任务,而CEASE仍然是所有保留度量衡和COCO CLIP分数的编辑方法中最好的。 雕塑记忆可以实现较低的COCOFID,但代价是大量退化的保留物。 重要的是,CEASE的保存收益并非来自使被抹去的样式保持不变:它仍然大幅降低被抹去的CLIP得分,其抹去的美学得分停留在参考水平上,表明被改编的作品仍然是连贯的绘画,而RIECE和CUIG-GradProj则产生美学崩溃的图像.

blocks.en: Erasure of Instances. As reported in Table 3 , the instance task exhibits SPEED’s mildest yet still substantial degradation, and CEASE again leads all retain and COCO preservation metrics while clearly altering the erased instances. ConAbl and RECE erase more deeply by erase-set CLIP score, but their collapsed retain scores expose the corresponding loss of selectivity. The accuracy columns make this explicit: CEASE keeps retain accuracy closest to the unedited reference while reducing erase accuracy to a low level, whereas the deepest-erasing baselines lose both together.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2017-03-21). Erasure of Ectures. 如表3所示,实例任务显示,SPEED的退化程度最轻,但仍然相当严重,CEASE再次领导所有保留和COCO保全指标,同时明确改变被清除的事例。 ConAbl和RECE通过擦除设定的CLIP得分更深刻地擦除,但他们崩溃的留存得分暴露了相应的选择性损失. 准确性各栏明确了这一点:CEASE保持了最接近未经编辑的参考文献的准确性,同时将抹去的准确性降低到低水平,而最深的变形基线同时失去。

blocks.en: Qualitative Results. Figure 3 compares all methods on the erased target “Hillary Clinton”, the retained concept “Jason Statham”, and an unrelated MS-COCO prompt. RECE, UCE, and CUIG-GradProj collapse all three categories alike to black or noise; SPEED and ConAbl distort the erased identity and, like Sculpting Memory, replace the retained one; ESD leaves the erased target fully recognizable. In contrast, CEASE redirects the target to a coherent anchor substitute while leaving the retained concept and the COCO scene visually intact. More visualization results on the celebrity, style, and instance tasks, as well as on the Stable Diffusion v1.5 and v2.1 backbones, are provided in Appendix A.7 , we observe the same pattern in those settings.
blocks.zh: 定性结果. 图3比较了被清除目标“希拉里·克林顿”上的所有方法、所保留的概念“Jason Statham”和不相关的MS-CO提示。 RECE,UCE,和CUIG-GradProj都崩溃为黑色或噪声;SPEED和ConABl扭曲了被抹去的身份,和雕刻记忆一样,取代保留的身份;ESD让被抹去的目标完全可以识别. 与此相对照,CEASE将目标重定向到一个连贯的主锚替代上,同时留下保留的概念和COCO场景在视觉上完好无损. 更多关于名人、风格和实例任务以及稳定扩散 v1.5 和 v2.1 的主干线的可视化结果载于附录A.7,我们在这些环境中也观察到同样的模式。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Qualitative comparison after the 100-step continual erasure, on the erased target Hillary Clinton, the retained concept Jason Statham, and an unrelated MS-COCO prompt. CEASE redirects the target to a coherent anchor substitute while preserving the retained concept and the COCO scene.
blocks.zh: 图3:100步持续消除后的质量比较,关于被清除的目标希拉里·克林顿,保留的概念杰森·斯塔特姆,以及一个无关的MS-CO的提示. CEASE在保留保留概念和COCO场景的同时,将目标重定向到一个连贯的主锚替代.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.3 读取研究

blocks.en: Table 4: Ablation of AIC and HOC on the celebrity task. Combining both modules improves retained-concept preservation and general generation quality. Bold marks the best results.
blocks.zh: 表4:AIC和HOC在名人任务上的差异. 将这两个单元结合起来,可提高保留概念的保存和一般生成质量。 粗体标出最佳成绩.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Cross-attention layer-scope ablation on the 100-step celebrity sequence. We compare four editing scopes using erase and retain CLIP scores and recognition accuracy, together with COCO CLIP score and FID. Arrows indicate the preferred direction.
blocks.zh: 图4:百步名人序列上的跨观察层镜断裂. 我们用擦除和保留CLIP分数和识别精度以及COCO CLIP分数和FID来比较四个编辑范围. 箭头指示首选方向.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Cross-edit interference over 100 celebrity erasures, comparing SPEED, RECE, UCE, and CEASE. The three panels track noise on unrelated COCO prompts, the shared replacement “person”, and the erased target “Tom Cruise” as successive edits accumulate.
blocks.zh: 图5:对100个名人时代的交叉编辑干扰,比较SPEED,REECE,UCE,和CEASE. 三个板块跟踪不相关的COCO提示、共享替换“人”和连续编辑累积的被删除目标“Tom Cruis”上的噪音。

blocks.en: Effect of AIC and HOC. Table 4 isolates the two components on the celebrity task. Each component alone already recovers much of the preservation lost by the baseline, with AIC contributing the larger gain, and their combination performs best on all retain and COCO metrics. The erase-set columns show the accompanying trade-off: the full method changes the erased celebrities less strongly than the baseline, redirecting them to coherent anchor substitutes rather than removing them more weakly, so the preservation gain does not come at the cost of failed erasure.
blocks.zh: AIC和HOC的影响。 表4将名人任务的两个组成部分隔离开来. 单是每个组成部分就已经收回了基线损失的大部分保全,而人工智能公司则贡献了更大的收益,其组合在所有留存量和COCO度量方面表现最好。 擦除设置的柱子显示了伴随的权衡:全方法改变了被擦除的名人不如基线的强烈,将其转向连贯的锚替代物而不是更弱的去除,因此保存收益不会以失败的擦除为代价.

blocks.en: Cross-Attention Layer Scope. Figure 4 compares four layer scopes on the celebrity sequence. The middle and high-resolution scopes preserve non-target behavior but fail to erase, whereas the low-resolution and all-stage variants erase effectively with similar preservation. All Stages achieves the strongest erasure overall while retaining comparable utility, so we use it as the default.
blocks.zh: 跨射层范围. 图4比较了名人序列上的四层瞄准镜. 中高分辨率瞄准镜保留了非目标行为,但未能抹去,而低分辨率和所有阶段的变体则以类似保存方式有效抹去. 所有阶段都实现了整体最强的消除,同时保留了可比较的效用,所以我们用它作为默认.

blocks.en: Cross-Edit Interference over the Sequence. Figure 5 traces the value-projection interference of SPEED, RECE with one adversarial epoch per request, UCE, and CEASE over the 100-step celebrity sequence. For SPEED, interference grows steadily on unrelated COCO prompts, on the shared replacement, and on the erased target, and the target curve rises sharply in the final edits. RECE exceeds the displayed range within the first ten edits and ends several orders of magnitude higher, consistent with its COCO FID in Fig. 1 (a). CEASE stays below SPEED on all three diagnostics; on the shared replacement it remains near zero, which is the direct effect of AIC. UCE is the exception that shows the limits of this diagnostic: its final interference on the shared replacement is three orders of magnitude above CEASE, while its unscaled COCO and target values end slightly lower despite far worse generation quality (the displayed UCE curve is scaled by a factor of two and ends above CEASE), so value-projection interference alone does not rank preservation across methods. Figure 13 reports the COCO CLIP score and the target-averaged diagnostic at five checkpoints; relative to SPEED, CEASE keeps a higher CLIP score and lower FID at every checkpoint. The underlying measurements use saved checkpoints from complete sequential runs; UCE is displayed with the stated post-processing scale; the projection diagnostic is interpreted separately from generation quality (Appendix A.8 ).
blocks.zh: 跨编辑干扰序. 图5追踪了SPEED、REECE、UCE和CEASE对100步名人序列的数值预测干扰,每个请求都有一个对抗的时代。 对SPEED来说,干扰在无关的COCO提示,共享替换,以及被抹去的目标上稳步增加,目标曲线在最终编辑中急剧上升. RECE在前十部编辑中超过了显示范围,结束数个数量级更高,与图1(a)中的COCO FID一致. CEASE在所有三种诊断上都保持在SPEED以下;在共享替代上仍然保持接近零,这是AIC的直接影响. UCE是显示这一诊断极限的例外:其对共享替换的最终干扰是CEASE以上的3个数量级,而其未缩放的COCO和目标值尽管生成质量差得多(显示的UCE曲线缩放为2倍,末端高于CEASE),但结束时会略微低一些(因此仅值-预测干扰并不能对跨方法的保存进行排序). 图13报告了COCO CLIP的得分和5个检查站的目标平均诊断;相对于SPEED,CEASE在每个检查站都保持较高的CLIP得分和较低的FID. 基本测量方法使用从完整连续运行中节省下来的检查点;UCE用说明的处理后尺度显示;预测诊断与生成质量分开解释(附录A.8)。

blocks.en: In addition, we analyze the robustness of CEASE to the erasure order in Appendix A.5 , and compare its computational efficiency with all baselines in Appendix A.6 .
blocks.zh: 此外,我们分析CEASE与附录A.5中的清除顺序的强性,并将其计算效率与附录A.6中的所有基线进行比较。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We studied continual concept erasure, where deletion requests arrive one after another and each edit builds on all previous ones. We traced the severe degradation of existing methods in this regime to accumulating cross-edit interference, and proposed CEASE, a training-free framework that protects the shared anchor and steers each new update away from the directions perturbed by past edits. Experiments on erasing celebrities, artistic styles, and instances across multiple backbones show that CEASE achieves the most consistent erase–preserve trade-off.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了持续的概念消除,即删除请求逐一收到,每部编辑都以以前的所有请求为基础。 我们追踪了这一制度中现有方法的严重退化,积累了跨编辑干扰,并提议建立无培训框架,保护共享锚,使每个新的更新都远离过去编辑所扰动的方向。 有关抹去名人、艺术风格和跨多个骨干的例子的实验表明,CEASE实现了最一致的抹去-保守权衡。

blocks.en: Limitations. First, our experiments focus on the Stable Diffusion family, and extending CEASE to more recent architectures such as FLUX is a natural next step. Second, this work instantiates the proposed constraints in a closed-form solver, and generalizing them to training-based erasure methods is left to future work. Third, our sequences contain up to 100 edits; evaluating substantially longer streams is conceptually straightforward but computationally expensive, since every additional step requires regenerating and re-evaluating thousands of images.
blocks.zh: 限制。 首先,我们的实验侧重于稳定扩散家族,将CEASE扩展到更近期的建筑如FLUX是自然的下一步. 第二,这项工作将封闭式解析器中的拟议限制立即进行,将其归纳为基于培训的消除方法则留给今后的工作。 第三,我们的序列包含多达100个编辑;在概念上,评估更长的溪流是直截了当的,但计算成本很高,因为每一个额外的步骤都需要重新生成和重新评价数千幅图像。

(2023) uses the ESD-x variant, fine-tuning the cross-attention projections under the negative-guidance objective for 200 Adam iterations per step at learning rate 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} with guidance strength 1.0, and training latents are generated at guidance 3.0 over 50 DDIM steps.
blocks.zh: ESD Gandikota 等人(2023年)使用ESD-x变体,在负指导目标下微调每步200 Adam迭代的交叉预测,学习速度为 1×10−4 1\times 10×4),指导强度为1.0,在指引3.0至50 DDIM步骤下产生训练潜伏.

blocks.en: ConAbl Kumari et al. (2023) fine-tunes the cross-attention weights toward its own anchor-prompt prediction, with prior-loss weight 1.0 and 100 Adam iterations per concept at learning rate 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} .
blocks.zh: ConAbl Kumari 等人(2023年)将交叉注意力的权重调整为自己的锚点即时预测,每个概念的前损失权重为1.0和100亚当迭代,学习速度为1×10−4 1\时为10×4}。

blocks.en: UCE Gandikota et al. (2024) applies one closed-form least-squares update per step to the key and value projections, with erase scale 1.0, preserve scale 1.0, and regularization λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 .
blocks.zh: UCE Gandikota 等人(2024年)对密钥和值预测每步采用一个闭式最小方位更新,并涂抹1.0级,保留1.0级,规范化QQ=0.5\lambda=0.5.

blocks.en: RECE Gong et al. (2024) alternates a closed-form value edit with the derivation of an adversarial target embedding, in the replace regime with 3 adversarial epochs, erase scale 1.0, preserve scale 0.1, closed-form λ = 0.1 \lambda=0.1 , and adversarial regularization 0.1.
blocks.zh: 欧洲经委会 龚等人. (2024)替换一个封闭式值编辑,并衍生出一个对立式目标嵌入式,在替换制中替换为3个对抗式时段,擦除1.0级,保留0.1级,封闭式QQ=0.1\lambda=0.1级,对抗式规范0.1级.

blocks.en: SPEED Li et al. (2026) redirects each target to the anchor while projecting the update onto the null space of an augmented retain set; its invariance matrix uses the empty-prompt representation, and CEASE’s AIC additionally inserts the task anchor. Both use null-space threshold 0.1, retain scale 0.05, λ = 0 \lambda=0 , 10 augmented retain samples per concept, and the official multi-concept configuration without the importance-based retain filter.

blocks.en: CUIG-GradProj Lee et al. (2026) adds the official semantic-aware gradient-projection regularizer to ConAbl with 200 auxiliary prompts, fine-tuning the key and value projections with batch size 4, learning rate 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} before the official scaling, 500 warmup steps, and weight decay 10 − 2 10^{-2} , for 2,000 iterations per request (1,000 for style).

blocks.en: A.3 Backbone Generalization to Stable Diffusion v1.5
blocks.zh: A.3 后骨 一般化为稳定扩散v1.5

blocks.en: We repeat the full 100-step sequence on Stable Diffusion v1.5, a second CLIP-L backbone, for all tasks and baselines, and report the results in Tables 5 , 6 , and 7 . The erase–preserve pattern of the main results transfers: CEASE improves the retain and COCO preservation metrics over SPEED on all three tasks while still altering the erased targets, and its aesthetic scores on styles stay at the reference level. The baselines that erase more deeply pay for it on preservation: ConAbl attains a lower COCO FID on celebrity and style but largely destroys the retained concepts, and UCE and RECE erase deepest with collapsed retain sets.
blocks.zh: 我们重复稳定扩散 v1.5 上的全部100步序列,这是第二个CLIP-L主干线,用于所有任务和基线,并在表5、表6和表7中报告结果。 主要结果转移的擦除-保存模式:CEASE改进了所有三项任务的保留和COCO保存度量衡,同时仍然改变被擦除的目标,它在样式上的美学分数保持在参考水平。 将它抹去的基线在保存时付出的代价更深: ConAbl在名人和风格上获得较低的COCO FID,但在很大程度上摧毁了保留的概念,UCE和RECE被倒塌的保存套装抹去最深处.

blocks.en: A.4 Backbone Generalization to Stable Diffusion v2.1
blocks.zh: A.4 后骨 一般化为稳定扩散 v2.1

blocks.en: Stable Diffusion v2.1 replaces the CLIP-L text encoder with the 1024-dimensional OpenCLIP-H and is the hardest tested backbone: every method erases more weakly, and the margins narrow accordingly (Tables 8 , 9 , and 10 ). CEASE still improves the retain and COCO preservation metrics over SPEED on all three tasks, whereas some baselines preserve well only because they barely erase: UCE leaves most of the erased celebrities recognizable, and ESD leaves the erased instances nearly intact. Overall, the transfer study supports a consistent preservation advantage over the underlying SPEED solver across both text encoders, at the cost of shallower erasure on several tasks.
blocks.zh: Stable Difusion v2.1将CLIP-L文本编码器替换为1024维的OpenCLIP-H,并且是最经过测试的骨干:每一种方法都擦除得更弱,边角也相应缩小(表8,9,和10). CEASE仍然改进了在所有三项任务中与SPEED相比的保留和COCO保全指标,而一些基线之所以保存良好,只是因为它们几乎无法消除: UCE使得大部分被抹去的名人可以辨认,而ESD使得被抹去的事例几乎完好无损. 总体而言,转移研究支持在两个文本编码器上对基础的SPEED解码器具有一致的保存优势,而在若干任务上则以更浅的消除为代价.

blocks.en: A.7 Additional Qualitative Comparisons
blocks.zh: A.7 其他定性比较

blocks.en: This section provides qualitative comparisons beyond the single case shown in the main text. Fig. 7 extends the main-text comparison to four cases per category on the celebrity task, Figs. 8 and 9 give the same comparison on the style and instance tasks, and Figs. 10 and 11 repeat the celebrity comparison on the Stable Diffusion v1.5 and v2.1 backbones. Every figure follows the same layout: columns show the unedited reference followed by ESD, UCE, ConAbl, RECE, SPEED, CUIG-GradProj, Sculpting Memory, and CEASE after the full 100-step sequence, and the three row blocks show four cases each of erased targets, retained concepts, and unrelated MS-COCO prompts.
blocks.zh: 本节在正文所示的单一案例之外提供定性比较. 图7将主文比较范围扩大到名人任务每类4个案例,图. 8和9对风格和实例任务进行了同样的比较,图10和图11重复了"稳定传播 v1.5"和v2.1主干线上的名人比较. 每个图都遵循相同的布局:各栏显示ESD,UCE,ConABl,RECE,SPEED,CUIG-GradProj,雕塑记忆,以及CEASE在完整100步序列后所遵循的未经编辑的参考文献,三行块显示被抹去的目标,保留的概念,以及无关的MS-COCO提示四个案例.

blocks.en: The failure modes match the quantitative results and the main-text analysis. On the erased rows, CEASE redirects each target to a coherent anchor substitute, whereas ESD often leaves the erased identity or style still recognizable, and RECE, UCE, and CUIG-GradProj collapse to noise-like textures once the sequence is long. Sculpting Memory remains photorealistic but drifts to subjects unrelated to either the target or its anchor. On the retained and COCO rows, the picture inverts: the destructive baselines corrupt concepts they were never asked to erase, SPEED preserves some cases but degrades others as its accumulated interference grows, and CEASE stays visually closest to the reference across both row blocks. The v1.5 and v2.1 figures show the same pattern, confirming that these behaviors are properties of the continual setting rather than of the v1.4 backbone.
blocks.zh: 失败模式符合定量结果和主文本分析. 在被擦除的行上,CEASE将每个目标重定向到一个连贯的锚代替物,而ESD则经常让被擦除的身份或样式仍然可以识别,RECE,UCE,以及CUIG-GradProj在序列长时崩溃到类似噪音的纹理. 雕刻记忆仍然具有光现实性,但漂移到与目标或其锚无关的主体上. 在保留和COCO行上,图片反转:破坏性基线腐蚀了它们从未被要求删除的概念,SPEED保留了一些案例,但随着其累积干扰的增加而降低其他案例,CEASE在两行块上都保持最接近参考. v1.5和v2.1的数字显示了相同的模式,证实了这些行为是持续设置的属性,而不是v1.4的主干.
